blocks.title: How Corning operates
blocks.text: Corning develops and manufactures materials-science products using glass science, ceramic science, optical physics, and manufacturing and engineering capabilities. Its 2026 reportable segments are Optical Communications, Glass Innovations, Automotive, and Solar; Life Sciences and Emerging Growth Businesses are grouped together.

evidence.quote: Corning applies its unparalleled expertise in glass science, ceramic science, and optical physics, along with its deep manufacturing and engineering capabilities

blocks.title: Segment structure
blocks.text: The company revised its segment structure in the first quarter of fiscal 2026 to align with how management reviews performance and allocates resources.

evidence.quote: Effective in the first quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company revised its segment structure.

blocks.title: Reported growth drivers
blocks.text: For the quarter, management attributed the net-sales increase primarily to optical communications products (+$506 million) and polycrystalline silicon and solar products (+$207 million).

evidence.quote: Optical Communications grew sales 32% to $2.07 billion, including a 65% increase in Enterprise Networks, with Gen AI product sales growing significantly faster.

blocks.title: Growth strategy and investment
blocks.text: Management says it intends to pursue profitable growth, higher returns on invested capital, and increased free cash flow, and expects to invest in capacity and technology where appropriate to support customer demand and long-term objectives.

evidence.quote: We expect to invest in capacity expansion and technology capabilities where appropriate to support customer demand

blocks.title: Tax dispute exposure
blocks.text: The company reports ongoing IRS examinations of U.S. federal returns for 2015–2018 and 2019–2020 and says an unsuccessful defense could have a material financial-statement impact.

evidence.quote: if the Company is ultimately unsuccessful in defending its position, the impact could be material to its consolidated financial statements.
